fields.v: Threats: search completeness (public indexed files only); 10-star threshold (checked at 5 and 25 stars); snapshot of April 2026, young repos; Claude Code only; subjective manual labels; LLM classification bias and single run; agent detection is a lower bound. Gaps: semantic differencing, instruction linting, consistency checks between scripts and SKILL.md, automated propagation of interface changes; longitudinal follow-up; other agent platforms; human-AI collaboration over plugin lifecycle
